newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indonesia allocates 3.7 mln barrels of March LSWR.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia allocates 3.7 mln barrels of March LSWR.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company, Pertamina, allocated a total of 3.7 million barrels of low sulphur waxy resideue (LSWR) for loading in March, the same amount allocated in February, traders said on Wednesday.

British Petroleum Co Plc (BP) has been allocated 1.1 million barrels, Indoil 750,000 barrels, Perta 550,000 barrels, Far East Investment 520,000 barrels, Pacific Petroleum Trading 400,000 barrels, Kipco 200,000 barrels and Itochu Corp 180,000 barrels, traders said.
Details on the loading schedules were not yet available, traders said. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870-3571)
